tpms.when: 2023–2025 (indirect tire pressure monitoring, set from the center display)
steps: With the car switched off, set all four tires to the cold pressure on the decal on the driver's door pillar.
Switch the car on and keep it standing still. The button only works while the car is stationary and ready to drive.
On the center display, tap the car symbol, then More, then Car status.
Tap Store pressure, check the pressures shown are the recommended ones, and confirm in the second step.
Drive above about 22 mph (35 km/h). The new pressures are stored while you drive; the progress animation on the center display disappears when it is done.
tpms.note: Do this after every tire change or pressure adjustment, or the low-pressure warning will not work correctly. If the screen says storing failed, try again. Checked against the maker's UK and Australian manuals; menu names can change with software updates.

notes: Fully electric, so there is no oil change reminder. The owner's manual pages we checked describe no driver reset for a service reminder.
